ui.tagline: Check instrument recordings against the score
ui.audioHint: DI track, e.g. WAV or FLAC
ui.tuningHint: Only needed if the score has none or differs
ui.customTuningHint: low → high, e.g. B1 E2 A2 D3 G3 B3 E4
ui.outdated: This analysis was made with an older version – newer checks and translations are missing.
ui.confirmDelete: Delete this analysis including the uploaded files?
ui.prerollTitle: How far before the finding playback starts
ui.confidenceTitle: Each finding has a confidence from 0 to 1: how sure the analysis is that it is a real playing mistake and not a detection artifact. Findings below the threshold are hidden.
ui.confTitle: Confidence {value} – how sure the analysis is that this is a real playing mistake
ui.copyTitle: Copy the list for the musician
ui.extraTitle: Extra note – not in the score
ui.extraExplain: Detected in the recording but not notated: e.g. a wrong or additional note, or a string ringing along.
ui.restExplain: Something still rings in the notated rest – audible in the mix if not muted.

ai.title: AI check
ai.privacy: Sends only analysis data (findings, bars, notes – no audio, no score file) to the Anthropic API ({model}).
ai.notConfigured: No Anthropic API key configured: start the server with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or create a key file (see README).
ai.stale: The analysis was recomputed after this AI check – references may be off. Please check again.
ai.disclaimer: AI assessment based on the automatic analysis – please verify by ear.

ui.tierHigh: {n} certain – very likely real playing mistakes (confidence 0.7 and above)
ui.tierMedium: {n} likely (confidence 0.5–0.7, shown in the default view)
ui.aiBadgeStale: AI check outdated – the analysis was recomputed afterwards ({langs})

msg.alignment_uncertain: Alignment uncertain: only {percent} of the notes match. Please check the offset or set it manually.
msg.pm_indistinct: Palm-muted and open notes sound almost the same in this take – possibly everything was muted or nothing was. Per-note palm mute check skipped.
msg.pm_lift_suffix: (downbeat/change – players often lift the palm briefly here)
msg.pm_unexpected: Played muted, but no palm mute notated: {note}
msg.picked_legato: No pick attack audible (legato instead of picked?): {note}
msg.chord_check_unavailable: Chord tones can hardly be told apart from neighbouring notes in this take – chord check uses the transcription only.
msg.missing_note_spectral: Missing note: {note} (chord of {n} notes, barely present in the spectrum)
msg.pm_upper_typical: Typical for palm muting: the upper chord tone on {where} barely sounds in {bars} bars ({count} of {total} notes) – the palm mutes upper strings more, or the pick misses them in chugs. Bars: {ranges}. Only relevant if the full chord should be audible.
msg.chord_tone_pattern: Noticeable: the chord tone on {where}{label} is very quiet or absent in {bars} bars ({count} of {total} notes; uncertain). Bars: {ranges}. Individual findings are downgraded – please listen whether this is intended.
msg.harmonic_timbre: Sounds fretted rather than like a harmonic ({note}) – experimental
msg.bend_missing: Bend missing: {note} should be bent by {amount}
msg.bend_too_flat: Bend too flat: {cents} cents at the target ({note} + {amount})
msg.bend_too_sharp: Bend too sharp: {cents} cents at the target ({note} + {amount})
msg.bend_late: Bend is late: target reached {ms} ms after the notation ({note})
msg.prebend_missing: Pre-bend not prepared: the note was bent up only after picking ({note})
msg.release_incomplete: Incomplete release: ends {cents} cents above the starting note
msg.unwanted_bend: Note pulled/out of tune without a notated bend: {cents} cents ({note})
msg.rests_ringing_general: Rests generally keep ringing in this take (on average {db} dB below the playing level) – only the most noticeable ones are reported.
msg.rest_ringing: Rest not muted: {db} dB below playing level{ringing}, {ms} ms rest
msg.rest_decay_suffix: – after a long held note, possibly left to decay on purpose
msg.slow_strum: Dragged strum: {ms} ms from first to last string ({notes}{arrow})
msg.groove_section_ahead: Bars {from}–{to}: plays consistently about {ms} ms ahead of the click (a matter of style, not an error – timing is judged against this groove).
msg.groove_section_behind: Bars {from}–{to}: plays consistently about {ms} ms behind the click (a matter of style, not an error – timing is judged against this groove).
msg.harmonic_pinch_failed: Pinch harmonic didn't sound: {played} instead of {expected} (harmonic)
msg.harmonic_fretted: Fretted instead of harmonic: {played} instead of {expected} (harmonic)
msg.suffix_octave: – off by an octave (may also be a detection error)
msg.too_short: Too short: {played} ms instead of {expected} ms ({note})
msg.score_no_tuning_assumed: No tuning found in the file – assuming standard tuning.
msg.score_no_tuning: No tuning found in the score – using notated pitches. Set the tuning manually if needed.
msg.score_tempo_ramp: Bar {bar}: tempo transitions (accelerando/ritardando) are approximated in steps.
msg.score_more_strings: The score uses more strings than the tuning has – using notated pitches.
msg.score_string_exceeds: The score uses string {string}, but the tuning only has {strings} strings – using notated pitches.
msg.midi_no_articulation: MIDI score: palm mutes, legato, bends and harmonics are not checked.
msg.midi_multiple_tracks: Several tracks with notes found – using the one with the most notes.
msg.midi_no_notes: The MIDI file contains no notes.
msg.err_score_ext: The score must be one of {exts}
msg.err_audio_ext: The recording must be one of {exts}
msg.err_not_ready: The analysis is not finished yet
msg.err_no_api_key: No Anthropic API key: start the server with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or a key file
msg.ai_err_permission: The API key lacks the required permission
msg.ai_err_rate: Rate limit reached – please try again later
msg.cli_no_api_key: No Anthropic API key found (set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or TAKE_CHECK_API_KEY_FILE).
